name: Pool of Ask'ar
summary: Naga invaders and aquatic beasts crowd Pool of Ask'ar, deep within Blackfathom Deeps. Beneath its waters lie night elven stonework and passages into the corrupted sanctuary.

sections.title: Depths of the Sunken Grotto
sections.body:
Past the Drowned Sacellum, cold water fills Pool of Ask'ar beneath a vast cavern roof. Oversized snapping turtles and deep-sea crabs nest among natural caverns and ancient stonework. Ghamoo-ra, an enormous ancient chelonian, watches over them.

Naga have seized the temple and guard this flooded threshold. Their patrols watch the approaches leading deeper into the complex, toward Lady Sarevess and the Moonshrine Ruins.

sections.title: Secrets Beneath the Surface
sections.body:
Dangerous creatures and naga patrols guard relics from the shrine's past, before the Sundering. Submerged ledges and hidden alcoves along the cavern's edges hold lost artifacts, including the Lorgalis Manuscript sought by Gerrig Bonegrip, a dwarven scholar from Ironforge.

Swim through the flooded southern passages to reach dry tunnels guarded by vile murlocs and Old God cultists. The pool remains a vital waterway through Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.q: What is the Pool of Ask'ar?
faq.answer: Past the Drowned Sacellum, Pool of Ask'ar lies deep within Blackfathom Deeps beneath a vast cavern. Snapping turtles, crabs, and naga guards crowd its waters.

faq.q: Who lives in this subterranean pool?
faq.answer: Snapping turtles and crabs inhabit the cavern, with Ghamoo-ra, an enormous ancient chelonian, among them. Hostile naga patrol the submerged banks and nearby chambers.

faq.q: Where do the underwater tunnels lead?
faq.answer: Flooded southern passages lead toward chambers occupied by Lady Sarevess and Argent Guard Thaelrid. They also open onto a route past Gelihast toward the Moonshrine Ruins.

faq.q: What notable items can be found in the pool?
faq.answer: Submerged ruins around the pool hold the Lorgalis Manuscript, an ancient text on the Old Gods sought by Gerrig Bonegrip of Ironforge.

angles.text: For night elves, Pool of Ask'ar drowns grounds once holy to Elune. Ancient architecture lies submerged, and naga scavenge sacred relics such as the Lorgalis Manuscript.
As an Alliance member, you must breach the waterways to uncover Argent Guard Thaelrid's fate. He entered these depths on a holy mission against the Twilight's Hammer.
